title: Guesswork Under Linear Constraints: Exact Exponent for Coset Decoding
summary: We establish the exact exponential growth rate of the $ρ$-th moment of the constrained guesswork $G_{\mathrm{coset}}$ -- the rank of the true noise vector within its syndrome coset of a random binary linear code under i.i.d.\ Bernoulli$(p)$ noise: \( \lim_{n\to\infty} \frac{1}{n}\log_2\Eb\!\left[G_{\mathrm{coset}}^ρ\right] = ρ\,h_{\frac{1}{1+ρ}}(p)\;+\;ρ(R-1), \, ρ>0, \) where $h_α(p)$ is the binary Rényi entropy and $R=k/n$ is the code rate. The exponent shifts down by exactly $ρ(1-R)$ relative to the unconstrained Arıkan--Merhav exponent, with each of the $n(1-R)$ parity checks…
